items.title: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Bone Lesions on CT Scans of Metastatic Spine Disease Patients: A 3D-Convolutional Neural Network Approach
items.abstract_or_text: Purpose: Clinical assessment of vertebral lesion quality (osteolytic, osteoblastic, mixed) remains subjective, with limited interobserver reliability. This study evaluated a novel application of 3D convolutional neural networks (3D-CNNs) for classifying lesion quality from CT volumes in metastatic cancer patients. Materials and Methods: This retrospective study used CT data from 151 cancer patients planned for radiotherapy for metastatic spine disease (September 2020-July 2024). Leveraging vertebra-level expert annotations, we introduced an unconventional U-Net-based strategy converting coarse voxel-wise predictions into vertebra-level lesion classifications. The final dataset comprised 2,125 vertebrae across four classes (no lesion, osteolytic, osteoblastic, mixed), split into a 3-fold cross-validation set and an independent holdout test set. Model performance was benchmarked against a DenseNet121 baseline and a musculoskeletal radiologist, with Cohen's kappa assessing inter-rater agreement. Results: The 3D model achieved an ensemble accuracy of 84.7%, outperforming DenseNet121 (72.1%), with substantial gains in F1 score, precision, and balanced accuracy. It showed high concordance with the radiologist (Cohen's kappa = 0.76) and comparable sensitivity and specificity across all lesion subtypes. We found both models and the radiologist to struggle with osteolytic lesions, reflecting the difficulty of distinguishing this class from age-related changes in vertebral bone density and architecture caused by benign bone lesions, age-related systemic skeletal disorders and cancer treatments. Conclusions: 3D-CNNs trained with vertebra-level labels can accurately and reliably classify vertebral metastatic lesion quality from CT scans, offering a scalable path toward automated characterization of metastatic spine disease to support clinical decision-making and large-scale radiomics research.
items.summary_zh: 回顾性纳入 151 名转移性脊柱肿瘤患者、2,125 个椎体，以 3D-CNN 将粗粒度体素预测转为椎体病灶类型判定；三折验证和独立留出集上，集成模型准确率为 84.7%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将 CT 病灶分型标准化可辅助放疗规划与影像组学研究；溶骨性病灶仍较难区分，且需多中心前瞻性检验后才能评估临床应用。
items.author_line: Hong, V., Bulent, A., Haouchine, N. 等 13 人
items.abstract_zh: 目的：椎体病变性质（溶骨性、成骨性、混合性）的临床评估仍具主观性，观察者间可靠性有限。本研究评估了三维卷积神经网络（3D-CNN）在转移性癌症患者 CT 容积中分类病变性质的新应用。材料与方法：这项回顾性研究使用了 151 例计划接受转移性脊柱疾病放疗的癌症患者的 CT 数据（2020 年 9 月至 2024 年 7 月）。利用椎体水平的专家标注，我们引入了一种非常规的基于 U-Net 的策略，将粗粒度体素级预测转换为椎体水平病变分类。最终数据集包含 2,125 个椎体，分为四类（无病变、溶骨性、成骨性、混合性），划分为 3 折交叉验证集和独立留出测试集。模型性能以 DenseNet121 基线和一名肌肉骨骼放射科医师为基准，并用 Cohen's kappa 评估评分者间一致性。结果：该 3D 模型的集成准确率为 84.7%，优于 DenseNet121（72.1%），在 F1 分数、精确率和平衡准确率方面均有显著提升。其与放射科医师高度一致（Cohen's kappa = 0.76），并在所有病变亚型中具有相当的灵敏度和特异度。我们发现两种模型及放射科医师在溶骨性病变上均较困难，这反映了将该类与良性骨病变、年龄相关全身性骨骼疾病及癌症治疗所引起的椎体骨密度与结构的年龄相关改变相区分的难度。结论：使用椎体水平标签训练的 3D-CNN 可从 CT 扫描准确、可靠地分类椎体转移性病变性质，为转移性脊柱疾病的自动化表征提供了可扩展路径，以支持临床决策和大规模放射组学研究。

items.title: Early Detection of Erythropoietic Protoporphyria Using Sequential Machine Learning on Longitudinal Electronic Health Records
items.abstract_or_text: Objective: Erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP) is a rare photodermatosis marked by multi-year diagnostic delays. We developed and externally validated machine learning models to identify patients with EPP earlier from longitudinal electronic health record (EHR) data and estimate undiagnosed disease burden. Materials and Methods: In a retrospective case-control study at two San Francisco health systems, an academic referral center (UCSF) and a safety-net hospital (ZSFG) we identified 74 confirmed EPP cases using combined diagnostic coding, biochemical criteria, and specialty chart review. Symptom-enriched controls were sampled at a 40:1 ratio. Longitudinal diagnoses, laboratory results, medications, procedures, and encounters preceding the outcome date were modeled with a gradient-boosting classifier (CatBoost) and a state-space sequence model (MAMBA). The best model was deployed across the UCSF population and externally validated at ZSFG without retraining. Results: On the UCSF held-out test set (n=1,865; 43 cases), MAMBA outperformed CatBoost (AUC ROC 0.91 vs 0.89; average precision 0.42 vs 0.27; precision 65% vs 20%), flagging cases a median of 229 days before documented diagnosis. Deployed across 297,967 symptom-compatible patients, it identified 310 high-risk individuals, implying a prevalence approaching genetic estimates. External validation at ZSFG showed attenuated performance (AUC ROC 0.72; average precision 0.10) while preserving early detection (median 264 days). Discussion: A sequence model integrating temporal EHR signals detected EPP months before clinical recognition, corroborating genetic evidence of substantial underdiagnosis. Cross-site attenuation reflects population and documentation differences and underscores the need for local recalibration. Conclusion: Longitudinal EHR-based machine learning can shorten EPP diagnostic delay and prioritize patients for confirmatory testing, supporting proactive rare-disease case finding.
items.summary_zh: 在两家旧金山医疗系统的纵向电子病历中，以 74 例确诊红细胞生成性原卟啉症训练时序模型，并在未重训的外部医院检验。外部 AUC 为 0.72，模型可在记录诊断前中位 264 天提示高风险。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 少见病的诊断延迟是实际临床问题；跨院性能下降提示模型可用于提示后续确证检查，部署前仍需本地校准。
items.author_line: Ayati, A., Onal, G., Sur, A. 等 6 人
items.abstract_zh: 目的：红细胞生成性原卟啉病（EPP）是一种罕见光线性皮肤病，诊断延迟常达数年。我们开发并外部验证了机器学习模型，以从纵向电子健康记录（EHR）数据中更早识别 EPP 患者，并估计未诊断疾病负担。材料与方法：在旧金山两家卫生系统——一家学术转诊中心（UCSF）和一家安全网医院（ZSFG）——开展的回顾性病例对照研究中，我们结合诊断编码、生化标准和专科病历审阅，确认了 74 例 EPP 病例。症状富集对照按 40:1 比例抽样。结局日期之前的纵向诊断、实验室结果、用药、操作和就诊，分别用梯度提升分类器（CatBoost）和状态空间序列模型（MAMBA）建模。最佳模型在 UCSF 人群中部署，并在 ZSFG 未经再训练的情况下进行外部验证。结果：在 UCSF 留出测试集上（n=1,865；43 例病例），MAMBA 优于 CatBoost（AUC ROC 0.91 vs 0.89；平均精确率 0.42 vs 0.27；精确率 65% vs 20%），在记录诊断前中位 229 天标记出病例。在 297,967 名症状相符患者中部署后，识别出 310 名高风险个体，提示患病率接近遗传学估计。在 ZSFG 的外部验证显示性能衰减（AUC ROC 0.72；平均精确率 0.10），但仍保持早期检测能力（中位 264 天）。讨论：整合时序 EHR 信号的序列模型可在临床识别前数月检出 EPP，印证了存在大量漏诊的遗传学证据。跨站点性能衰减反映人群与记录差异，并强调需要本地再校准。结论：基于纵向 EHR 的机器学习可缩短 EPP 诊断延迟并优先安排患者进行确诊检测，支持主动的罕见病病例发现。

items.title: VRK1 kinase maintains an undifferentiated proliferative state in neuroblastoma tumor cells
creators: Gomez Munoz, M. d. l. A.
items.abstract_or_text: Neuroblastoma is a neural crest-derived pediatric malignancy characterized by marked cellular heterogeneity and variable differentiation status. Undifferentiated tumors are associated with aggressive clinical behavior, treatment resistance and poor outcome, highlighting the need to identify molecular mechanisms that sustain tumor cell plasticity and prevent differentiation. Vaccinia-related kinase 1 (VRK1) is a serine/threonine kinase involved in cell-cycle progression, DNA-damage responses and transcriptional regulation, and has previously been associated with neuroblastoma progression. However, its role in the control of neuroblastoma differentiation remains unclear. Here, we investigated the relationship between VRK1 expression, tumor differentiation and stem-like properties in human neuroblastoma. Analysis of patient tumor datasets and tissue microarrays showed that VRK1 expression is enriched in undifferentiated neuroblastoma and stage 4 tumors, and inversely correlates with established differentiation markers, including DDC, NCAM1 and S100B. This association was maintained in MYCN-non-amplified tumors, indicating that the relationship between VRK1 and differentiation is not dependent on MYCN status. Single-cell transcriptomic analyses further demonstrated elevated VRK1 expression in developmentally immature neural crest progenitor and Schwann cell precursor-like populations. Induction of neuronal or mesenchymal differentiation consistently reduced VRK1 expression in neuroblastoma cell lines and patient-derived cells. Conversely, VRK1 silencing promoted differentiation-marker expression, reduced nestin and Ki67 expression, and produced sustained differentiation-associated changes in xenograft tumors. VRK1 was also enriched in tumorsphere cultures that select for undifferentiated stem-like neuroblastoma cells. VRK1 depletion impaired tumorsphere growth, reduced intratumoral proliferation and altered the balance between undifferentiated cells and differentiated progeny, supporting a role for VRK1 in self-renewal and maintenance of progenitor-like tumor cells. Mechanistically, VRK1 expression positively correlated with the core stemness transcription factor SOX2 in neuroblastoma tumor cells. VRK1 knockdown reduced nuclear SOX2 abundance, whereas VRK1 overexpression increased SOX2 protein levels. In addition, analysis of the VRK1 locus identified an active chromatin configuration and potential SOX2-binding sites, consistent with a regulatory relationship between these factors. Together, these findings identify VRK1 as a regulator of the undifferentiated, proliferative and stem-like state in neuroblastoma. The VRK1-SOX2 axis may contribute to stabilizing tumor-cell immaturity and represents a potential target for differentiation based therapeutic strategies in high-risk neuroblastoma.
items.summary_zh: 结合患者肿瘤数据、组织芯片、单细胞转录组、细胞系与患者来源细胞以及异种移植模型，研究显示抑制 VRK1 会伴随神经母细胞瘤分化标志上升与增殖降低。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多层实验将未分化肿瘤状态与 VRK1 联系起来，为研究分化治疗提供了可检验的分子线索；治疗靶点价值仍待进一步药理学验证。
authors: Gomez Munoz, M. d. l. A.
items.author_line: Ojeda-Puertas, M., Gomez Munoz, M. d. l. A., Colmenero-Repiso, A. 等 7 人
items.abstract_zh: 神经母细胞瘤是一种源自神经嵴的儿科恶性肿瘤，其特征为显著的细胞异质性和可变的分化状态。未分化肿瘤与侵袭性临床行为、治疗抵抗和不良预后相关，这凸显了鉴定维持肿瘤细胞可塑性并阻止分化的分子机制的必要性。牛痘相关激酶1（VRK1）是一种参与细胞周期进程、DNA损伤应答和转录调控的丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶，此前已被关联到神经母细胞瘤进展。然而，其在神经母细胞瘤分化调控中的作用仍不明确。在此，我们研究了人神经母细胞瘤中VRK1表达、肿瘤分化与干细胞样特性之间的关系。对患者肿瘤数据集和组织芯片的分析显示，VRK1表达在未分化神经母细胞瘤和4期肿瘤中富集，并与包括DDC、NCAM1和S100B在内的既定分化标志物呈负相关。该关联在MYCN非扩增肿瘤中仍然成立，表明VRK1与分化之间的关系并不依赖于MYCN状态。单细胞转录组分析进一步表明，VRK1在发育上不成熟的神经嵴祖细胞和施万细胞前体样群体中表达升高。诱导神经元或间充质分化可在神经母细胞瘤细胞系和患者来源细胞中一致地降低VRK1表达。相反，沉默VRK1促进了分化标志物表达，降低了nestin和Ki67表达，并在异种移植肿瘤中产生了持续的分化相关改变。VRK1也在筛选未分化干细胞样神经母细胞瘤细胞的肿瘤球培养中富集。耗竭VRK1损害肿瘤球生长、降低瘤内增殖，并改变未分化细胞与分化后代之间的平衡，支持VRK1在自我更新及维持祖细胞样肿瘤细胞中的作用。机制上，VRK1表达与神经母细胞瘤肿瘤细胞中的核心干性转录因子SOX2呈正相关。敲低VRK1降低核内SOX2丰度，而过表达VRK1则提高SOX2蛋白水平。此外，对VRK1位点的分析鉴定出活跃染色质构型和潜在的SOX2结合位点，与这些因子之间存在调控关系相一致。综合来看，这些发现将VRK1鉴定为神经母细胞瘤中未分化、增殖性和干细胞样状态的调控因子。VRK1-SOX2轴可能有助于稳定肿瘤细胞的未成熟状态，并代表高危神经母细胞瘤中基于分化的治疗策略的潜在靶点。

items.title: PerturbLDM: conditional latent diffusion for modelling single-cell perturbation responses
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell perturbation profiling maps intervention-induced phenotypes, yet experiments measure only a fraction of the perturbation-context space. Learning context-dependent perturbation effects could enable response prediction beyond measured conditions. Here we introduce PerturbLDM, a latent-diffusion framework for conditional generation of single-cell transcriptional responses. Following Tahoe-100M pretraining, it outperformed leading methods across 13,942 held-out combinations of observed drugs, doses and cell lines, with higher matched-control effect correlation than an additive marginal baseline in 95.2% of conditions. The Tahoe-100M-pretrained model was further used to rank PANACEA compounds by pathway similarity, placing shared-mechanism pairs among nearest neighbours. In smaller datasets, PerturbLDM generated a mid-gestational fetal-colon state with 67% lower gene-wise error than Squidiff, retaining the balance between absorptive and BEST4/OTOP2-like epithelial programmes. In PBMCs, it captured six of seven interferon and antiviral programmes and the interferon-associated FAO- OXPHOS programme more accurately than scGen. Together, these results support conditional response generation across data scales and biological settings.
items.summary_zh: PerturbLDM 以潜空间扩散模型生成单细胞转录扰动响应；经 Tahoe-100M 预训练后，在 13,942 个药物、剂量和细胞系留出组合中优于比较方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 可为未测扰动条件提出转录响应假设，并在不同数据规模中检验泛化；生成结果适合作为实验优先级依据，不能替代实际扰动测量。
items.author_line: Yu, L., Hsieh, K.-L., Chu, Y. 等 13 人
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞扰动分析可绘制干预诱导的表型，但实验仅能测量扰动–背景空间中的一小部分。学习依赖于背景的扰动效应，有望在已测条件之外预测应答。本文介绍PerturbLDM，这是一个用于条件生成单细胞转录应答的潜扩散框架。在Tahoe-100M预训练之后，该模型在13,942个留出的已观测药物、剂量与细胞系组合上优于领先方法，并在95.2%的条件中比加性边际基线具有更高的匹配对照效应相关性。Tahoe-100M预训练模型还被进一步用于按通路相似性对PANACEA化合物排序，将共享机制的配对置于最近邻之中。在较小数据集中，PerturbLDM生成了妊娠中期胎儿结肠状态，基因水平误差比Squidiff低67%，并保留了吸收性与BEST4/OTOP2样上皮程序之间的平衡。在PBMC中，它比scGen更准确地捕捉了七种干扰素与抗病毒程序中的六种，以及干扰素相关的FAO-OXPHOS程序。综合来看，这些结果支持在不同数据规模和生物学场景下进行条件应答生成。

items.title: Integration of proteomic data from cell lines and tumors
items.abstract_or_text: Cancer cell lines are widely used in preclinical research, yet the clinical translation of findings from cell lines remains limited. Identifying cell lines that best resemble patient tumors requires integration of molecular profiles across biologically distinct sample types. Recent advances in transcriptomic integration have demonstrated the potential of deep learning for aligning data across different sample types. However, comparable approaches for proteomic data integration remain lacking, potentially because of the prevalence of missing values in proteomic datasets. Here, we introduce ProtInt, a deep learning-based framework that integrates proteomic data from cell lines and patient tumors by combining principles from proteomic imputation and transcriptomic integration methods. We applied ProtInt to integrate label-free proteomic profiles from 771 cancer cell lines and 550 treatment-naive tumors. ProtInt outperformed batch correction and transcriptomic integration methods in aligning cell line and tumor proteomes. Comparison of the cell line proteomes before and after integration revealed recurrent increase of proteins associated with immune reaction, cell-cell communication, and interaction with the extracellular matrix, and reduction of proteins involved in transcription, post-transcriptional processing, and mitochondrial gene expression as proteomes of cell lines were adapted to resemble tumors. These results establish ProtInt as a framework for joint analysis of proteomic datasets across distinct sample types and may facilitate the identification of cell lines best suited for clinically relevant studies.
items.summary_zh: ProtInt 将蛋白质组缺失值处理与跨样本类型整合结合，用于对齐 771 个癌细胞系和 550 例治疗前肿瘤的无标记蛋白质组。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 细胞系与患者肿瘤的蛋白质组可比性是转化研究中的关键问题；该方法有望帮助选择更贴近肿瘤状态的模型，临床外推仍需独立研究确认。
items.author_line: Ta, C. Q., Auth, J. M., Schilling, M. 等 5 人
items.abstract_zh: 癌细胞系被广泛用于临床前研究，但来自细胞系的发现向临床的转化仍然有限。鉴定最接近患者肿瘤的细胞系，需要跨生物学上不同的样本类型整合分子图谱。转录组整合的近期进展已显示深度学习在对齐不同样本类型数据方面的潜力。然而，蛋白质组数据整合的可比方法仍然缺乏，这可能是由于蛋白质组数据集中缺失值普遍存在。本文介绍ProtInt，这是一个基于深度学习的框架，通过结合蛋白质组填补与转录组整合方法的原理，整合来自细胞系和患者肿瘤的蛋白质组数据。我们将ProtInt应用于整合771个癌细胞系和550个未经治疗肿瘤的无标记蛋白质组图谱。在对齐细胞系与肿瘤蛋白质组方面，ProtInt优于批次校正和转录组整合方法。对整合前后细胞系蛋白质组的比较显示，随着细胞系蛋白质组被调整以接近肿瘤，与免疫反应、细胞间通讯以及与细胞外基质相互作用相关的蛋白质反复增加，而参与转录、转录后加工和线粒体基因表达的蛋白质减少。这些结果确立了ProtInt作为跨不同样本类型联合分析蛋白质组数据集的框架，并可能有助于鉴定最适于临床相关研究的细胞系。

items.title: Long-Read epigenetic clocks identify improved brain aging predictions
items.abstract_or_text: Epigenetic clocks are widely used to estimate biological aging, yet most are built from array-based data from peripheral tissues of predominantly European-ancestry individuals, limiting their generalizability. Here, we present aging clocks on DNA methylation from Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing (LRS), leveraging over 28 million CpG sites from prefrontal cortex samples across individuals of African and European ancestry. These models were developed using GenoML, an automated machine learning platform for multi-omics data that leverages a diverse catalog of existing model architectures. Our long-read-informed clocks were developed using promoter-based and whole-genome window-based features, yielding models for each individual cohort as well as a combined-cohort clock. Each of these models demonstrated favorable performance compared to existing methylation clocks and was externally validated in a cohort of Colombian individuals. We further performed enrichment analyses and nominated both shared and cohort-specific pathways, cell types, and transcription factor binding motifs which may be implicated in aging and were not fully explained by cell type proportions or postmortem interval. Altogether, our findings highlight the power of long-read methylation data for constructing accurate, ancestry-aware aging clocks and emphasize the importance of inclusive training datasets.
items.summary_zh: 研究以牛津纳米孔长读长甲基化数据构建脑衰老时钟，覆盖逾 2,800 万 CpG 位点、非洲与欧洲祖源前额叶样本，并在哥伦比亚队列进行外部检验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 长读长和多祖源训练有助于改善传统外周血、单一祖源时钟的局限；其对脑衰老机制和个体层面预测的增益仍须更多队列复现。
items.author_line: Grant, S. M., Eger, S. J., Makarious, M. B. 等 25 人
items.abstract_zh: 表观遗传时钟被广泛用于估计生物学衰老，但大多数基于主要为欧洲血统个体外周组织的芯片数据构建，限制了其泛化性。本文基于 Oxford Nanopore 长读长测序（LRS）的 DNA 甲基化提出衰老时钟，利用来自非洲与欧洲血统个体前额叶皮层样本的超过 2800 万个 CpG 位点。这些模型使用 GenoML 开发，这是一个面向多组学数据的自动化机器学习平台，借助多样化的现有模型架构目录。我们的长读长信息时钟使用基于启动子与基于全基因组窗口的特征开发，得到各单独队列模型以及一个合并队列时钟。这些模型相对现有甲基化时钟均表现出更优性能，并在哥伦比亚个体队列中得到外部验证。我们进一步进行富集分析，提名了可能与衰老相关、且不能完全由细胞类型比例或死后间隔解释的共享及队列特异性通路、细胞类型与转录因子结合基序。综上，我们的发现凸显了长读长甲基化数据在构建准确、血统感知衰老时钟方面的能力，并强调包容性训练数据集的重要性。

items.title: Bioprinted Human Primary Arteries Recapitulate Inflammatory Activation and Pharmacologic Rescue
items.abstract_or_text: Chronic inflammation drives persistent systemic cytokine signaling that contributes to vascular dysfunction and secondary vasculitis, yet mechanistic studies are limited by models that fail to capture the multicellular architecture and dynamics of human arteries. In contrast, perfusing intact vessels ex vivo has limited tractability because of material availability and difficulty of genetic or biochemical manipulation. We developed a modular, perfused artery-on-a-chip platform by tri-axially bioprinting primary human vascular cells to recapitulate the concentric organization of the intimal, medial, and adventitial layers. The engineered vessels are viable longer than 21 days, with functional endothelial barriers, contractile smooth muscle behavior, and actively remodeled extracellular matrices bearing hallmarks of native vascular tissue. Addition of tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF) induces altered transcript levels of proinflammatory mediators and secretion of cytokines and matrix-remodeling enzymes without compromising vessel viability. Importantly, this secretory response is effectively attenuated by both a small-molecule JAK1 inhibitor (ABT-317) and anti-TNF antibody (Infliximab), demonstrating model utility for therapeutic evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 利用原代人血管细胞三轴生物打印构建灌流动脉芯片，维持超过 21 天的屏障、收缩和基质重塑特征；TNF-α 诱导的炎症分泌可被 JAK1 抑制剂或英夫利昔单抗减弱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该人源多层血管模型可用于研究炎症性血管反应与候选干预；药物反应来自体外系统，尚不能推及患者疗效。
items.author_line: Fu, Z., Fastiggi, V. A., Phelan, A. 等 8 人
items.abstract_zh: 慢性炎症驱动持续的系统性细胞因子信号，促进血管功能障碍和继发性血管炎，但现有模型未能捕捉人动脉的多细胞架构与动态，限制了机制研究。相比之下，离体灌注完整血管因材料可获得性有限以及遗传或生化操作困难，可操作性不足。我们通过三轴生物打印原代人血管细胞，开发了模块化、可灌注的芯片上动脉平台，以重现内膜、中膜和外膜的同心层状组织。工程化血管存活超过 21 天，具有功能性内皮屏障、收缩性平滑肌行为，以及带有天然血管组织标志的主动重塑细胞外基质。加入肿瘤坏死因子 α（TNF）可诱导促炎介质转录水平改变以及细胞因子和基质重塑酶的分泌，且不损害血管活力。重要的是，这一分泌应答可被小分子 JAK1 抑制剂（ABT-317）和抗 TNF 抗体（英夫利西单抗，Infliximab）有效减弱，显示该模型可用于治疗评估。

items.title: FluoroFate: A generalisable platform for time-resolved single-cell analysis of cell fate enables quantification of cell death dynamics
items.abstract_or_text: Fundamental cellular decisions of life and death are governed by intricate and tightly regulated intracellular signalling pathways that determine whether cells proliferate, enter quiescence, or undergo programmed cell death (apoptosis). Live-cell fluorescence imaging enables these processes to be observed in real time at single-cell resolution, but two problems limit their study. First, existing biosensors do not allow apoptotic status and cell cycle progression to be resolved in tandem within the same cell. Second, interpreting live-cell imaging data is challenging even where multiplex reporters exist, as the biological meaning of fluorescent signals depends on their temporal ordering, and large-scale imaging experiments generate complex, multidimensional data that are difficult to analyse systematically and at scale. Here we address both problems. We present FluoroFate, a generalisable and user-friendly graphical interface-driven tool for time-resolved single-cell analysis of multiplex live-cell imaging datasets, which integrates existing, robust deep learning-based segmentation, cell tracking, and temporal classification methods to quantify fluorescent reporter dynamics in individual cells across time without the need for specialist computational expertise. Alongside FluoroFate, we develop tricistronic Fluorescent Ubiquitination-based Cell Cycle Indicator (Fucci) and apoptosis biosensors, enabling simultaneous monitoring of cell cycle progression and caspase activation within the same cell. Applying FluoroFate, we resolve apoptotic and non-apoptotic cell death at the single-cell level based on the temporal ordering of Annexin V and propidium iodide signals, identifying distinct kinetic and phenotypic cell death profiles in response to pharmacological perturbation. We highlight divergent temporal dynamics and modes of cell death between birinapant and cycloheximide treatment, reflecting differences in how TNF/TNFR1 signalling is disrupted by these agents. At the single-cell level, we uncover parallel, independently regulated death programmes, demonstrating that loss of RIPK1 selectively impairs apoptotic cell death whilst leaving non-apoptotic death largely unaffected. We then use FluoroFate to analyse timelapse images of our combined Fucci-apoptosis reporters, resolving cell cycle progression and caspase activation within the same cell over time. Together, FluoroFate and our new cell cycle and apoptosis biosensors represent a broadly applicable platform for extracting mechanistic insight from live-cell imaging data.
items.summary_zh: FluoroFate 将细胞分割、追踪和时间分类整合为图形化单细胞活细胞成像分析平台，并配套细胞周期与凋亡双报告系统，量化药物扰动下不同死亡过程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工具使非专门计算用户也能分析大规模时序成像，并把细胞周期、半胱天冬酶激活和死亡顺序置于同一读出中。
items.author_line: Preedy, M. K., Taylor-Hearn, I., Ying, C. 等 8 人
items.abstract_zh: 细胞生死的基本决策由复杂且严格调控的细胞内信号通路支配，这些通路决定细胞增殖、进入静止或发生程序性细胞死亡（凋亡）。活细胞荧光成像可在单细胞分辨率下实时观察这些过程，但其研究受两个问题限制。其一，现有生物传感器无法在同一细胞内同时分辨凋亡状态与细胞周期进程。其二，即便存在多重报告子，解读活细胞成像数据仍具挑战，因为荧光信号的生物学含义取决于其时间顺序，且大规模成像实验产生复杂的多维数据，难以系统、规模化分析。本文同时解决这两个问题。我们提出 FluoroFate，这是一款可泛化、用户友好、图形界面驱动的工具，用于多重活细胞成像数据集的时间分辨单细胞分析。它整合现有稳健的基于深度学习的分割、细胞追踪和时间分类方法，无需专业计算技能即可定量单个细胞中荧光报告子随时间的动态。在 FluoroFate 之外，我们还开发了三顺反子荧光泛素化细胞周期指示剂（Fucci）与凋亡生物传感器，从而在同一细胞内同时监测细胞周期进程和半胱天冬酶激活。应用 FluoroFate，我们基于 Annexin V 与碘化丙啶信号的时间顺序，在单细胞水平分辨凋亡与非凋亡性细胞死亡，并鉴定出药理学扰动下不同的细胞死亡动力学与表型谱。我们强调 birinapant 与环己酰亚胺处理之间细胞死亡时间动态与模式的差异，这反映了这些药物干扰 TNF/TNFR1 信号的方式不同。在单细胞水平，我们发现并行、独立调控的死亡程序，证明 RIPK1 缺失选择性损害凋亡性细胞死亡，而非凋亡性死亡基本不受影响。随后我们用 FluoroFate 分析联合 Fucci–凋亡报告子的延时图像，在同一细胞内随时间分辨细胞周期进程与半胱天冬酶激活。综上，FluoroFate 与我们新的细胞周期和凋亡生物传感器构成一个可广泛适用的平台，用于从活细胞成像数据中提取机制洞见。

items.title: Prospective Validation of a Deep Learning Model to Detect Structural Heart Disease from Apple Watch ECGs: The WATCH-SHD Study
items.abstract_or_text: Importance: Consumer wearables such as the Apple Watch can record single-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) but are used mainly to detect rhythm disorders. Artificial intelligence-enhanced ECG (AI-ECG) could extend these real-world recordings for detecting structural heart disease (SHD), yet prospective validation remains limited. Objective: To prospectively validate a previously developed, noise-adapted AI-ECG model for detecting severe SHD from single-lead Apple Watch ECGs. Design: Prospective cohort study. Setting: Yale New Haven Hospital echocardiography laboratory. Participants: Adults aged >=18 years undergoing outpatient transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) as part of routine clinical care. Exposure: A 30-second, single-lead Apple Watch ECG recorded during the TTE visit and processed through an end-to-end, HIPAA-compliant platform for real-time AI-ECG inference. Main Outcomes and Measures: The primary outcome was discrimination for TTE-defined severe SHD, a composite of left ventricular systolic dysfunction (left ventricular ejection fraction <40%), severe left-sided valvular disease, and/or severe left ventricular hypertrophy, assessed by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). Secondary measures were sensitivity, specificity, negative predictive value (NPV), and positive predictive value (PPV) at prespecified thresholds, and screening efficiency, assessed by the number needed to test (NNT) under usual-care versus AI-ECG-guided strategies. Results: Among 596 participants with analyzable Apple Watch ECGs (median age, 62 years [IQR, 46-72]; 51.2% women), severe SHD was present in 30 (5.1%). The model discriminated severe SHD well (AUROC, 0.841; 95% CI, 0.761-0.921), with a sensitivity of 76.7% (59.1-88.2), specificity of 83.2% (79.9-86.1), NPV of 98.5% (97.0-99.3), and PPV of 19.7% (13.5-27.8) at the prespecified threshold. An AI-ECG-guided strategy reduced the NNT to identify one case by more than 60% versus usual care across the composite and individual SHD phenotypes. Conclusions and Relevance: In this prospective cohort, a noise-adapted AI-ECG algorithm identified SHD phenotypes from real-world single-lead Apple Watch ECGs and improved screening efficiency. These findings support a potential role for wearable ECG-based screening in the scalable identification of clinically actionable SHD.
items.summary_zh: WATCH-SHD 在 596 名接受超声心动图的成人中前瞻性检验单导联 Apple Watch ECG 模型；30 例重度结构性心脏病的 AUROC 为 0.841，阴性预测值为 98.5%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 真实可穿戴设备数据的前瞻性检验是临床 AI 证据的重要补充；阳性预测值为 19.7%，更适合作为进一步超声评估的筛查提示。
items.author_line: Aminorroaya, A., Vasisht Shankar, S., Carter, M. 等 12 人
items.abstract_zh: 重要性：Apple Watch 等消费级可穿戴设备可记录单导联心电图（ECG），但目前主要用于检测节律障碍。人工智能增强心电图（AI-ECG）可将这些真实世界记录扩展用于检测结构性心脏病（SHD），但前瞻性验证仍然有限。目的：前瞻性验证先前开发的、经噪声适应的 AI-ECG 模型，用于从单导联 Apple Watch ECG 检测重度 SHD。设计：前瞻性队列研究。地点：Yale New Haven Hospital 超声心动图实验室。参与者：作为常规临床诊疗的一部分接受门诊经胸超声心动图（TTE）检查的年龄 >=18 岁成人。暴露：在 TTE 就诊期间记录 30 秒单导联 Apple Watch ECG，并通过端到端、符合 HIPAA 的平台进行实时 AI-ECG 推断。主要结局和指标：主要结局为对 TTE 定义的重度 SHD 的判别能力，重度 SHD 为左心室收缩功能障碍（左心室射血分数 <40%）、重度左侧瓣膜病和/或重度左心室肥厚的复合，以受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估。次要指标为预设阈值下的灵敏度、特异度、阴性预测值（NPV）和阳性预测值（PPV），以及筛查效率，以常规诊疗与 AI-ECG 引导策略下识别一例所需检测数（NNT）评估。结果：在 596 名具有可分析 Apple Watch ECG 的参与者中（年龄中位数 62 岁 [IQR，46-72]；51.2% 为女性），30 人（5.1%）存在重度 SHD。该模型对重度 SHD 判别良好（AUROC，0.841；95% CI，0.761-0.921），在预设阈值下灵敏度为 76.7%（59.1-88.2），特异度为 83.2%（79.9-86.1），NPV 为 98.5%（97.0-99.3），PPV 为 19.7%（13.5-27.8）。AI-ECG 引导策略将识别一例所需的 NNT 较常规诊疗降低超过 60%，在复合及各单项 SHD 表型中均如此。结论与相关性：在该前瞻性队列中，经噪声适应的 AI-ECG 算法可从真实世界单导联 Apple Watch ECG 识别 SHD 表型并提高筛查效率。这些发现支持可穿戴 ECG 筛查在可扩展识别具有临床可干预性 SHD 中的潜在作用。

items.title: Efficient exploration of sequence space enables rapid generation of functional genome editors
items.abstract_or_text: The problem of how protein sequences translate into defined functions remains largely unsolved despite decades of progress. New methods to efficiently explore protein sequence space will help to shed light on these sequence-function relationships, particularly for complex protein function. Here, we describe an approach to create novel, functional proteins through the integration of deep mutational scanning, structural analysis, and evolutionary mining within prompts for a generative protein language model (PLM). We demonstrate the utility of this approach with the generation of novel compact RNA-guided nucleases. This approach is highly efficient, resulting in active nucleases with ~40% sequence divergence relative to natural proteins and activity equivalent to or exceeding by up to ~3X that of other compact nucleases at multiple endogenous loci in human cells. The approach described here is rapidly deployable and produces new sequences that will serve as scaffolds for further exploration of complex protein functionality, as well as substrates for novel genome engineering applications.
items.summary_zh: 研究把深度突变扫描、结构分析和进化挖掘结果用于生成式蛋白语言模型提示，获得与天然蛋白约 40% 序列差异的紧凑 RNA 引导核酸酶，并在人细胞内源位点检验活性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在实验反馈和生成设计之间建立高效迭代，可扩展基因编辑器的序列空间；编辑效率、安全性和特异性仍需系统比较。
items.author_line: Hughes, N. W., Kulkarni, S., Goldman, G. 等 9 人
items.abstract_zh: 尽管数十年进展，蛋白质序列如何转化为确定功能这一问题在很大程度上仍未解决。高效探索蛋白质序列空间的新方法将有助于阐明这些序列–功能关系，尤其是复杂蛋白质功能。本文描述一种通过在生成式蛋白质语言模型（PLM）的提示中整合深度突变扫描、结构分析和进化挖掘来创建新型功能蛋白质的方法。我们以生成新型紧凑型 RNA 引导核酸酶展示了该方法的效用。该方法效率很高，所得活性核酸酶相对天然蛋白序列差异约 40%，在人细胞多个内源位点上的活性相当于或最高超出其他紧凑型核酸酶约 3 倍。本文所述方法可快速部署，产生的新序列将作为进一步探索复杂蛋白质功能的支架，也可作为新型基因组工程应用的底物。

items.title: Activity-based chemical proteomics uncovers unexpected covalent targetsof E64d and reveals a role for cysteine cathepsins in PLD3 proteostasis.
items.abstract_or_text: Catalytic activity of 5'-3' exonuclease Phospholipase D3 (PLD3) is associated with immune signaling and neurodegeneration including Alzheimer's disease. PLD3 undergoes multiple post-translational modifications and proteolytic cleavage to establish its catalytically active form. However, the proteases catalyzing the cleavage of PLD3 have remained unidentified. To study the proteolytic cleavage of PLD3, we have evaluated the small molecule covalent inhibitor E64d that blocks proteolysis catalyzed by cysteine cathepsins. To validate the selectivity of E64d, we have designed and synthetized an E64d propargyl analogue and carried out a detailed activity-based protein profiling to reveal a broad engagement of the compound with other protein targets including bleomycin hydrolase (BLMH), Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (KEAP1), transcription elongation factor SPT5 (SUPT5H) and asparagine synthetase (ASNS). The specificity of the E64d-protein interactions was confirmed by biochemical assays and mass spectrometry-based site identifications. In neurons, treatment with E64d lead to about 50-fold PLD3 accumulation and dysregulation of its proteolytic cleavage, while there was only a minor overall change on the whole proteome level. Taken together, this study provides insights into previously unknown E64d selectivity and renders cysteine cathepsins responsible for PLD3 degradation in neurons. It highlights the importance of cysteine cathepsins activity in neuronal lysosomes for proper PLD3 processing and hence it suggests that their activation might be responsible for decreased PLD3 levels in neurons of patients with Alzheimer's diseases. These findings are key for further elucidation of PLD3 function in neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary_zh: 以活性基化学蛋白质组学、竞争实验和质谱位点鉴定分析 E64d，发现其结合谱广于预期；在神经元中，该化合物处理伴随约 50 倍 PLD3 积累与加工改变。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果提示常用半胱氨酸组织蛋白酶抑制剂具有重要脱靶作用，并为 PLD3 蛋白稳态研究提出可检验的酶学机制。
items.abstract_zh: 5'-3' 外切核酸酶磷脂酶 D3（PLD3）的催化活性与免疫信号转导以及包括阿尔茨海默病在内的神经退行性疾病相关。PLD3 经历多种翻译后修饰和蛋白水解切割，以形成其催化活性形式。然而，催化 PLD3 切割的蛋白酶仍未被鉴定。为研究 PLD3 的蛋白水解切割，我们评估了可阻断半胱氨酸组织蛋白酶所催化蛋白水解的小分子共价抑制剂 E64d。为验证 E64d 的选择性，我们设计并合成了 E64d 炔丙基类似物，并开展了详细的基于活性的蛋白质谱分析，揭示该化合物还广泛作用于其他蛋白靶标，包括博来霉素水解酶（BLMH）、Kelch 样 ECH 相关蛋白 1（KEAP1）、转录延伸因子 SPT5（SUPT5H）以及天冬酰胺合成酶（ASNS）。E64d–蛋白相互作用的特异性通过生化实验和基于质谱的位点鉴定得到确认。在神经元中，E64d 处理导致 PLD3 约 50 倍蓄积及其蛋白水解切割失调，而全蛋白质组水平仅有轻微整体变化。综上，本研究揭示了此前未知的 E64d 选择性，并表明半胱氨酸组织蛋白酶负责神经元中 PLD3 的降解。研究强调了神经元溶酶体中半胱氨酸组织蛋白酶活性对 PLD3 正确加工的重要性，因而提示其激活可能是阿尔茨海默病患者神经元中 PLD3 水平降低的原因。这些发现对进一步阐明 PLD3 在神经退行性疾病中的功能至关重要。

items.title: Rise-and-fall dynamics reveal a molecular and cellular vulnerability axis in prion-like α-synuclein propagation
items.abstract_or_text: The spread of misfolded proteins through neuronal circuits is a defining feature of neurodegenerative disease, yet the dynamics underlying this process remain poorly understood. Most studies rely on sparsely sampled datasets that capture spatial patterns of pathology but not their temporal evolution. Here, we analyze longitudinal histopathology measurements of -synuclein pathology across hundreds of brain regions in a mouse model of Parkinson's disease. Network-based dynamical modeling shows that regional pathology does not simply accumulate but instead follows rise-and-fall trajectories across the brain. The inferred parameter landscape reveals a one-dimensional vulnerability axis along which regions with stronger fall dynamics have greater monoaminergic neuronal composition and higher expression of proteostatic and metabolic genes. This vulnerability axis replicates in an independent histopathological dataset, indicating that its dominant transcriptomic structure is preserved. Together, these results suggest that regional vulnerability collapses onto a low-dimensional molecular and cellular axis defined by rise-and-fall dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 对帕金森病小鼠模型中数百脑区的纵向 α-突触核蛋白病理数据进行网络动力学建模，发现病理可呈上升后下降轨迹，并在独立组织病理数据集中复现主要转录组结构。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 时间序列视角补充了单时点病理图谱，可提出脑区易感性与蛋白稳态、代谢特征有关的假设；该关系来自动物模型和关联分析。
items.author_line: Alexandersen, C. G., Brynildsen, J. K., Prigent, A. 等 8 人
items.abstract_zh: 错误折叠蛋白质经神经元回路扩散是神经退行性疾病的标志性特征，但该过程的底层动力学仍了解不足。多数研究依赖稀疏采样数据集，仅捕捉病理的空间模式而非其时间演化。本文分析帕金森病小鼠模型中数百个脑区 α-突触核蛋白病理的纵向组织病理学测量。基于网络的动力学建模表明，区域病理并非简单累积，而是在全脑呈现升–降轨迹。推断的参数图景揭示了一维易损性轴：沿该轴，下降动力学更强的区域具有更高的单胺能神经元组成，以及更高的蛋白稳态与代谢基因表达。该易损性轴在独立组织病理学数据集中得到复现，表明其主导转录组结构得以保留。综合来看，这些结果提示区域易损性坍缩到由升–降动力学定义的低维分子与细胞轴上。

items.title: Genetic regulation of right ventricular trabeculation identifies developmental and cardiopulmonary pathways
items.abstract_or_text: Right ventricular (RV) trabeculation may reflect adaptation to loading conditions and imprinting of early developmental processes, yet its genetic determinants and clinical relevance in adults remain poorly understood. In contrast to the left ventricle, the RV has distinct developmental origins, geometry and loading conditions, suggesting chamber-specific mechanisms of trabecular remodelling. Using deep learning-based image segmentation and fractal dimension analysis, we quantified RV trabecular complexity in diastole and systole in 48,118 UK Biobank participants with genetic data. RV trabecular morphology was associated with systolic function, as well as cardiometabolic and respiratory conditions. Genetic analyses across the allele frequency spectrum identified 52 common loci and 45 genes with a burden of protein-altering variants, implicating sarcomeric function, cytoskeletal organisation, and early cardiac patterning. Although many loci showed shared effects across both ventricles, we also identified RV-specific genetic associations linked to congenital heart disease and respiratory phenotypes. Notably, associations at CFTR suggest a connection between airway-associated mucus regulation and RV remodelling, whereas MYH6 implicates sarcomeric and developmental mechanisms in adult RV patterning. Together, these findings establish RV trabeculation as a trait that captures both shared and chamber-specific mechanisms relevant to cardiovascular health and disease.
items.summary_zh: 利用 UK Biobank 中 48,118 名具有遗传数据的参与者，以深度学习分割和分形分析量化右心室小梁复杂度，并识别 52 个常见位点和 45 个蛋白改变变异负荷相关基因。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大样本人群遗传学把右心室形态与发育、肌节和心肺相关通路联系起来，为理解心室特异性重塑提供资源；遗传关联本身不能确定具体致病机制。
items.author_line: McGurk, K. A., Sedlacik, J., Janan, R. 等 8 人
items.abstract_zh: 右心室（RV）肌小梁形成可能反映对负荷条件的适应以及早期发育过程的印记，但其遗传决定因素及在成人中的临床意义仍知之甚少。与左心室相比，RV 具有独特的发育起源、几何形态和负荷条件，提示肌小梁重塑存在心室特异性机制。我们利用基于深度学习的图像分割和分形维数分析，在 48,118 名具有遗传数据的 UK Biobank 参与者中量化了舒张期和收缩期的 RV 肌小梁复杂度。RV 肌小梁形态与收缩功能以及心血管代谢和呼吸系统疾病相关。跨越等位基因频率谱的遗传分析鉴定出 52 个常见位点和 45 个携带蛋白质改变变异负荷的基因，涉及肌节功能、细胞骨架组织和早期心脏模式形成。尽管许多位点在两个心室间显示共享效应，我们也鉴定出与先天性心脏病和呼吸表型相关的 RV 特异性遗传关联。值得注意的是，CFTR 处的关联提示气道相关黏液调节与 RV 重塑之间存在联系，而 MYH6 则提示肌节与发育机制参与成人 RV 模式形成。综上，这些发现确立 RV 肌小梁形成是一种可同时捕获与心血管健康和疾病相关的共享机制与心室特异性机制的性状。
